notes: Stationary means compact reported movement flag clear and both commanded/output PWMs zero. It is not physical stop confirmation.
Missing sequence numbers are capture gaps, not UART packet-loss measurements.
Runs end on sequence capture gaps, telemetry failure, stationary flag/PWM change, MODE, READY or captured link errors. Other traffic may remain.
MODE-to-GET_CONFIG is trigger proxy only for ordinary mode handler, not precise per-command enqueue time.
